code_lines: ﻿/*MANIPULA SIGNOS DE CUENTAS PARA CALCULAR VALORES NETOS DE LA CNF DE LOS HOGARES*/
SELECT t1.'AÑO'n format=best12., t1.TRIM format=best12.,(substr(PUT(t1.'AÑO'n,CHAR4.),3,2) ||"."|| PUT(t1.TRIM,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,
when t1.C_SCN IN('B.2/B.3','D.1','K.1') THEN 'Rentas de la producción'
when t1.C_SCN IN('D.41','D.42','D.43','D.44','D.443') THEN 'Rentas de la propiedad netas'
when t1.C_SCN IN('D.61','D.62') THEN 'Prestaciones sociales netas de cotizaciones'
when t1.C_SCN IN('D.71','D.72','D.75') THEN 'Transferencias corrientes netas'
when t1.C_SCN IN('D.63') THEN 'Transferencias sociales en especie'
WHEN t1.C_SCN IN('D.8') THEN 'Ajuste por la variación en la participación neta de los hogares en los fondos de pensiones' ELSE t1.N_SCN END) AS N_SCN_N1,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN='K.1' THEN 'YG' ELSE t1.C_CUENTA END) AS C_CUENTA,
sum(case when t1.C_ENTRADA='D' and t1.C_CUENTA='Capital' and t1.C_SCN<>'B.9' then t1.DATO*-1
when t1.C_ENTRADA='D' and t1.C_CUENTA='YG' then t1.DATO*-1
when t1.C_ENTRADA='H' and t1.C_CUENTA='Financiera' then t1.DATO*-1
else t1.DATO end)/1000 FORMAT COMMA14. AS DATO
where T1.AÑO>2002 AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14' AND T1.C_SCN<>('B.8') AND T1.C_CUENTA IN ('YG','Capital')
GROUP BY T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED N_SCN_N1,CALCULATED C_CUENTA,t1.c_scn;QUIT;
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,(substr(PUT(t1.'AÑO'n,CHAR4.),3,2) ||"."|| PUT(t1.TRIM,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,'Ingreso disponible bruto' AS N_SCN_N1,'YG' AS C_CUENTA,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END)/1000 FORMAT COMMA14. AS DATO
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,(substr(PUT(t1.'AÑO'n,CHAR4.),3,2) ||"."|| PUT(t1.TRIM,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,'Ahorro bruto' AS N_SCN_N1,'B.8' AS C_SCN, 'YG' AS C_CUENTA,
where T1.C_Cuenta IN ('Capital') AND T1.AÑO>2002 AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14' AND T1.C_SCN IN ('B.8','K.1')
SELECT * FROM WORK.CNF_HH_ OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM WORK.YD_TRIM OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM WORK.AHORRO_B;
/*AGRUPA DATOS PARA CALCULAR VAR ANUAL -PERIODO EN CURSO*/
CREATE TABLE WORK.CNF_HH_T AS SELECT  AÑO,TRIM, PERIODO,N_SCN_N1,c_scn,C_CUENTA,SUM(DATO) AS DATO
/*AGRUPA DATOS PARA CALCULAR VAR ANUALES PARA PERIODO T-1*/
SELECT (t1.'AÑO'n+1) AS AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.N_SCN_N1,T1.c_scn,T1.C_CUENTA,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
FROM WORK.CNF_HH t1 GROUP BY T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, T1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.c_scn;
SELECT T1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,t1.PERIODO, SUM(t2.DATO) as DATO1,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO,(SUM(t1.DATO)/SUM(t2.DATO))*100-100 FORMAT COMMA14.1 as VAR
where t1.'AÑO'n=t2.'AÑO'n and t1.TRIM=t2.TRIM and t1.N_SCN_N1=t2.N_SCN_N1 AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA AND T1.C_SCN=T2.C_SCN
/*CALCULA PARTICIPACIONES DEL INGRESO DISPONIBLE PARA CALCULO DE INCIDENCIAS*/
WHERE T1.N_SCN_N1 IN('Rentas de la producción','Rentas de la propiedad netas','Impuestos directos','Prestaciones sociales netas de cotizaciones','Transferencias corrientes netas');
SELECT T1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,t1.PERIODO, t1.DATO1 AS YD1,t1.DATO AS YD, t1.VAR
FROM WORK.CNF_VAR T1 where T1.N_SCN_N1 IN('Ingreso disponible bruto');
/*CALCULA INCIDENCIAS DE COMPONENTES DEL INGRESO DISPONIBLE*/
/*CALCULA INCIDENCIAS DE LAS RENTAS DE LA PROPIEDAD Y PRODUCCIÓN*/
(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN='K.1' THEN 'B.2/B.3' ELSE T1.C_SCN END) AS C_SCN ,
SUM(t2.DATO) as DATO1,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO,(SUM(t1.DATO)/SUM(t2.DATO))*100-100 FORMAT COMMA14.1 as VAR
where t1.'AÑO'n=t2.'AÑO'n and t1.TRIM=t2.TRIM and t1.N_SCN_N1=t2.N_SCN_N1 AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA AND T1.C_SCN=T2.C_SCN
and T1.N_SCN_N1 IN('Rentas de la producción','Rentas de la propiedad netas')
SELECT T1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,t1.PERIODO, t1.DATO1 AS YD1,t1.DATO AS YD, t1.VAR
FROM WORK.CNF_VAR T1 where T1.N_SCN_N1 IN('Rentas de la producción','Rentas de la propiedad netas');
PROC SQL;/*incidencias rentas de la prod y prop*/
where t1.'AÑO'n=t2.'AÑO'n and t1.TRIM=t2.TRIM AND T1.N_SCN_N1=T2.N_SCN_N1;
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA INGRESO DISPONIBLE Y SUS COMPONENTES (INCIDENCIAS)*/
SELECT T.PERIODO, T.YD format COMMA20.1, T.N_SCN_N1 AS GRUPO, SUM(T.YD) format COMMA20.1 label " Ingreso disponible" AS Ing_disponible
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA RENTAS DE LA PRODUCCION (INCIDENCIAS)*/
SELECT T.PERIODO, T.RENTAS format comma20.1, T.C_SCN AS GRUPO, SUM(T.RENTAS) format COMMA20.1 label "Rentas de la producción" AS Rentas_prod
VAR2="Rentas_prod" varlabel="Rentas de la producción" normal="yes"
title="COMPONENTES DE LAS RENTAS DE LA PRODUCCIÓN"
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA RENTAS DE LA PROPIEDAD (INCIDENCIAS)*/
SELECT T.PERIODO, T.RENTAS FORMAT COMMA20.1, T.C_SCN AS GRUPO,SUM(T.RENTAS) FORMAT COMMA20.1 LABEL "Rentas de la propiedad" AS Rentas_prop
WHERE N_SCN_N1='Rentas de la propiedad netas'
VAR2="Rentas_prop" varlabel="Rentas de la propiedad" normal="yes"
title="COMPONENTES DE LAS RENTAS DE LA PROPIEDAD"
SELECT T1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,t1.PERIODO,t1.VAR AS YD
FROM  WORK.CNF_VAR T1 where T1.N_SCN_N1 IN('Ingreso disponible bruto');
SELECT T1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,t1.PERIODO,t1.VAR AS CONSUMO
SELECT T1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, 'Gasto en consumo' AS N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA,t1.PERIODO,SUM(T1.DATO/T1.DATO1*100-100) AS GASTO_CONSUMO
where T1.N_SCN_N1 IN('Consumo final efectivo','Transferencias sociales en especie')
LEFT JOIN TABLAS.TIEMPO T3 ON (T1.AÑO=T3.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T3.TRIM) WHERE T1.N_SCN_N1='Ahorro bruto'
SELECT T1.AÑO_ACUM AS AÑO,T1.TRIM_ACUM AS TRIM,T1.PERIODO,
FROM WORK.B8_ACUM T1,WORK.PIB_ACUM T2,WORK.BD_YD_VAR T3 WHERE T1.AÑO_ACUM=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM_ACUM=T2.TRIM AND T1.AÑO_ACUM=T3.AÑO AND T1.TRIM_ACUM=T3.TRIM;QUIT;
/*CREA TABLA PARA COMPARAR INGRESO, CONSUMO Y AHORRO*/
CREATE TABLE WORK.BD_ICA AS SELECT * FROM WORK.BD_YD_VAR
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM WORK.BD_P4_VAR OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM WORK.B8_ID;QUIT;
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA COMPARAR INGRESO-CONSUMO-AHORRO*/
SELECT T.PERIODO, T.YD label "Ingreso disponible",T.AHORRO label "Tasa de ahorro (eje izq.)", T.N_SCN_N1,T.CONSUMO label "Consumo"
title="TASA DE AHORRO, INGRESO DISPONIBLE Y CONSUMO"
title2="(porcentaje del PIB y variaciones anuales)";
DATA=WORK.CNF_VAR (WHERE=(N_SCN_N1 = 'Formación bruta de capital fijo') KEEP=PERIODO VAR N_SCN_N1)
SELECT T3.AÑO_ACUM AS AÑO,T3.TRIM_ACUM AS TRIM,(PUT(t3.AÑO_ACUM,CHAR4.) ||"."|| PUT(t3.TRIM_ACUM,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,
T1.N_SCN_N1, SUM(((t1.DATO)/1000)/T4.DATO)*100 FORMAT COMMA14.1 AS DATO
LEFT JOIN TABLAS.TIEMPO T3 ON (T1.AÑO=T3.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T3.TRIM)
LEFT JOIN WORK.PIB_ACUM T4 ON (T3.AÑO_ACUM=T4.AÑO AND T3.TRIM_ACUM=T4.TRIM)
where T1.C_Cuenta=('Bce Final')  AND T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_SCN <>('B.90') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14'
/*CREA BASE CON INFO DEUDA HOGARES SOBRE PIB*/
WHEN T1.C_SI_C_AGENTE	IN(411) THEN 'Cajas de Compensación'
FROM WORK.DEUDA_HH T1, WORK.PIB_ACUM T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM
SELECT T.PERIODO, T.DATO as ratio, T.N_SI_C_AGENTE as grupo,sum(t.dato) format comma20.1 as Deuda
title="DEUDA A PIB DE LOS HOGARES";
/*DATA PARA AHORRO PREVISIONAL-NO PREVISIONAL DE LOS HOGARES*/
SELECT T3.AÑO_ACUM AS AÑO,T3.TRIM_ACUM AS TRIM,(substr(PUT(T3.AÑO_ACUM ,CHAR4.),3,2) ||"."|| PUT(t3.TRIM_acum,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,
LEFT JOIN TABLAS.TIEMPO T3 ON (T1.AÑO=T3.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T3.TRIM)
LEFT JOIN WORK.PIB_ACUM T4 ON (T3.AÑO_ACUM=T4.AÑO AND T3.TRIM_ACUM=T4.TRIM)
WHERE (T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.SECTOR=511 AND T1.C_SCN='B.8' AND T1.FUENTE='CI' AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D')
OR (T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.SECTOR in (34,341) AND T1.C_SCN='D.44' AND T1.FUENTE='DI_Aj_REAJ' AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D')
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE WORK.AH_NP AS /*AHORRO NO PREVISIONAL ACUMULADO*/
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,T1.PERIODO,(T1.AHORRO-T2.DATO) FORMAT COMMA14.1 AS DATO,'Ahorro no previsional' AS N_SCN_N1
FROM WORK.B8_ID T1, WORK.AH_P T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM;quit;
CREATE TABLE WORK.AH_P_NP AS SELECT * FROM WORK.AH_P OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM WORK.AH_NP;QUIT;
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE WORK.AH_P_NP_F AS SELECT * FROM WORK.AH_P_NP T1, WORK.B8_ID T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM;QUIT;
SELECT PERIODO, DATO, N_SCN_N1 as GRUPO,SUM(DATO) label "Ahorro (eje der.)" AS Ahorro
title="AHORRO PREVISIONAL/NO PREVISIONAL DE LOS HOGARES"
(CASE WHEN T4.C_SCN_N1 CONTAINS 'AF.52' THEN 'Cuotas de fondos'
WHEN T4.C_SCN_N1 IN ('AF.612') THEN 'Fondos de pensiones' ELSE T4.N_SCN_N0 END) AS N_SCN_N2,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END)/1000 FORMAT COMMA14. AS DATO
where T1.C_Cuenta=('Bce Final')  AND T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_SCN <>('B.90')  AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14'
/*CREA BASE CON INFO RFN SOBRE PIB*/
FROM WORK.RFN_HH T1, WORK.PIB_ACUM T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM
FROM WORK.RFN_HH T1, WORK.PIB_ACUM T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM
/*GRAFICO RIQUEZA FINANCIERA NETA HOGARES POR COMPONENTES*/
SELECT T.PERIODO, T.DATO AS RATIO, T.N_SCN_N2 AS GRUPO,SUM(T.DATO) label "Riqueza financiera neta" AS Riqueza
title="RIQUEZA FINANCIERA NETA DE LOS HOGARES (%PIB)";
/*DATA PARA CAPACIDAD DE FINANCIAMIENTO DE LOS HOGARES*/
PROC SQL; /*CF ACUMULADA Y A PIB*/
SELECT T5.AÑO_ACUM AS AÑO,T5.TRIM_ACUM AS TRIM,(substr(PUT(T5.AÑO_ACUM,CHAR4.),3,2) ||"."|| PUT(t5.TRIM_ACUM,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,
(CASE WHEN T4.C_SCN_N1 CONTAINS 'AF.52' THEN 'Cuotas de fondos'
WHEN T4.C_SCN_N1 IN ('AF.612') THEN 'Fondos de pensiones' ELSE T4.N_SCN_N0 END) AS N_SCN_N2,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END)/1000 AS DATO,
SUM(((CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END)/1000)/t6.dato)*100 AS RATIO
LEFT JOIN TABLAS.TIEMPO T5 ON (T1.AÑO=T5.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T5.TRIM)
LEFT JOIN WORK.PIB_ACUM T6 ON (T5.AÑO_ACUM=T6.AÑO AND T5.TRIM_ACUM=T6.TRIM)
LEFT JOIN T_MAX T7 ON (T6.AÑO=T7.AÑO AND T6.TRIM=T7.TRIM)
where T1.C_Cuenta=('Financiera')  AND T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_SCN <>('B.9')  AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14' and T6.DATO<>. AND T7.ID<>.

SELECT T.PERIODO,t.RATIO,SUM( T.RATIO) label "Préstamo neto"  AS Ptmo_neto, T.N_SCN_N2 as GRUPO

WHEN T4.C_SCN_N1 IN ('AF.29') THEN 'Otros depósitos' ELSE T4.N_SCN_N0 END) AS N_SCN_N2,
